title: Fixture
description: A kind of furniture or fitting a room can hold: which of the stage's drawings it is, its size, whether it takes up the floor, and how a person uses it.

draw.description: Which of the stage's drawings it is.

depth.description: From its front to its back, in metres (tune).

blocks.description: Whether it takes up the floor, so nobody steps where it stands. A rug does not.

use.description: How a person uses it: from which side, how far out, for what, and how the stage draws them doing it.

side.description: Where a person goes to use it, as it faces: left and right are its own.

gap.description: How far out from that side they stand, in metres.

serves.description: The activities it is a place for (DESIGN.md, Needs and mood).

pose.description: Standing or cooking at that side, or sitting or lying on it.
